items.title: Project Placeholder 01
items.summary: A high-conviction product build. Add the real description, stack, and what made it matter.
items.description: Use this slot for a fast, opinionated build that demonstrates taste, product judgment, and technical range.

items.title: Project Placeholder 02
items.summary: Use this card for something design-heavy, systems-heavy, or unusually technical.
items.description: Good fit for a project that lets you explain the constraints, tradeoffs, and craft behind the build.

items.title: Project Placeholder 03
items.summary: Reserve one slot for a polished personal build with a strong visual point of view.
items.description: Use this to show a project where the visual language and interaction model mattered as much as the engineering.

items.title: Project Placeholder 04
items.summary: Use this slot for a backend-heavy or infra-flavored project that shows range.
items.description: Ideal for a systems project with strong implementation detail or a meaningful architecture story.

items.title: Project Placeholder 05
items.summary: A project where speed of execution mattered. Fill in the result and learning later.
items.description: Good for a rapid prototype, hack week build, or an experiment that made a sharp product point.

items.title: Project Placeholder 06
items.summary: Keep one card free for the strongest future piece you want to feature prominently.
items.description: Use this for a future high-signal project with a sharp story and clear outcome once it is ready.
